what_this_is: Every token link the token-link audit found contradicted by the sentence, with the verified decision. One row per C-mode token, addressed by sentence SLUG and token POSITION. Assembled by scripts/assemble_token_link_repairs.py from research/derived/token_links/token_link_{audit,mechanical_sample,rulings-*}.json; applied by scripts/apply_token_link_repairs.py.

rules.guard: the token at (sentence, position) in split mode C must still carry old_vocab and read `surface`, else the row is refused
rules.edges: edge-exact: the new (sentence, vocab) pair is inserted; the old pair is deleted only when no C token, no R2 run (n5/n4 registry), no R3 lemma (n3 headword) and no ortho row still produces it
rules.levels: `sentence_levels`: the touched sentences whose computed level the relink moves (persist_dissection.computed_level, pre- vs post-relink edges over the corrected registry) get the new level; scoped, never corpus-wide

reading_uses_rule: W15 reading boxes carry `uses`, a snapshot of what their own tokenisation resolved to, and it resolved by written form exactly as the bank tokens did. Every uses entry naming one of the six records Q2 retires from the course (刷る, 生る, 罹る, 用, 報, 動) is re-decided from the passage's SudachiPy split-mode C tokens: replaced by the record the tokens normalize to (為る, 成る, 掛かる, 方), 用 by 様 where the only よう is the auxiliary stem, 動 dropped (どう has no record). A token that really is the retired record would keep it: none does. Applied to the index (reading.uses) and to the W15 table's snapshot (research/derived/repairs/reading_passages.json) by scripts/apply_token_link_repairs.py. The four W15-held boxes keep build_readings.py's link-derived selection, so their rows are index-only (the W15 table has no snapshot for them).
